Name: New Wizard for Vanilla - Seasonal Outfits and SVE
Author: rachelkel04
Description:
[size=4]I’ve made a few adjustments—I’m not sure if it will work correctly, but I’ve tried to ensure compatibility with the vanilla game, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450?tab=description]Seasonal Outfits[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]. If it doesn’t work or you encounter an error, simply take the images from my mod and replace the corresponding files in the original game or the mod you are trying to modify.[/size]


I thought our dear wizard deserved an improvement, so I made small changes to his haircut, face and added some accessories to his hat and outfit.



[size=4]There are 4 files:[/size]

[list=1]
[*]New Wizard - this one is for if you aren't using any other portrait mod; it’s for the base game.[/*]
[*]New Wizard Colorful for Seasonal Outfits - this one is for "Seasonal Outfits," where the hair and beard change color with each season.[/*]
[*]New Wizard  for Seasonal Outfits - this one is for "Seasonal Outfits," for cases where you do NOT want the hair and beard color to change—they will remain purple.[/*]
[*]New Wizard for SVE - this one is for SVE.[/*]
[/list]
If you are using any of the Seasonal Outfits, just remember to disable the "Wizard" option in the Seasonal Outfits settings.
﻿
[size=5][b]Installation:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Download the mod files and extract them to the Stardew Valley mods folder. (The path should be something like: C:\Program Files) Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Run the game normally[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]in case it doesn't work and you need to change the images manually:[/b][/size]

[size=4]Seasonal outfits version: [/size][size=2][If the seasonal code doesn't work, it's my fault—because AirynS's template is perfect.][/size]
[list]
[*]Download mod manually and unzip[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]You will find two folders: "Characters" and "Portraits"[/*]
[*]Copy the images from the 'portraits' folder to this path: [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters\assets\Portraits\Wizard, and replace the files.[/*]
[*]Copy the images from the 'characters' folder to this path: [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters\assets\Characters\Wizard, and replace the files.[/*]
[*]Run game as normal[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]SVE version:[/size]
[list]
[*]Download mod manually and unzip[/*]
[*]Open the "assets" folder [/*]
[/list][list]
[*]You will find two folders: "Characters" and "Portraits"[/*]
[*]Copy the images from the 'portraits' folder to this path: Stardew Valley Expanded\[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded\assets\CharacterFiles\OverworldSprites\Magnus, and replace the files.[/*]
[*]Copy the images from the 'characters' folder to this path: Stardew Valley Expanded\[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded\assets\CharacterFiles\Portraits\Magnus, and replace the files.[/*]
[*]Run game as normal[/*]
[/list]


I hope you like it! Feel free to comment if you have any feedback or if something isn't working. Thank you! 💖

[I generally don't know how to fix code errors, so if anyone knows how, please feel free to share. If anyone would like to make modifications and publish them on Nexus, you are welcome to do so—just remember to provide the proper credit.]
﻿
